name: String quartet for a gala or a wedding: Beethoven's Op. 18 No. 6, first two movements
seoTitle: String quartet for a gala or wedding: Beethoven Op. 18 No. 6
description: A string quartet of two violins, viola and cello plays the first two movements of Beethoven's Op. 18 No. 6, and you can hear how full the sound gets.
more: A full quartet is the size we'd choose for a church or a ballroom, and it's a great way to welcome guests to a black-tie gala. Indoors, a quartet can play a ceremony or a cocktail hour with nothing plugged in. Outdoors, or in a large hall, we can bring a small sound system.
